svg.title: A live event: scripted rivals in slices, the player's pulls and decisions

g.text: A live event: scripted rivals in slices, the player's pulls and decisions
create(rules, venue, field, ..., running_order, player, seed)
[at most max_steps steps, while the rivals are due]
a rival tries each gear (as best_gear);
the player only draws the guess
guess_gear: the rival's gear for the day
the rival's crew puts the sled across the lane
step the pull on sled() from there until it stops
the pit board: the lane as the crew saw it;
the player's run on that sled from there, frame by frame
record (the player's on_this_pull draw is taken)
